reports.title: Mantle Op-geth & Op-stack Diff Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin diff audit (Everest, v1.1.1) of Mantle's EigenDA/blob data-availability changes in the mantle-v2 op-batcher, op-node and op-service Go code (c77cb6e vs fd99099) and of op-geth changes (4a20fa6 vs 87c2ac2, PR #93 RIP-7212 P256 precompile, PR #95 meta-transaction disabling). The scope is entirely offchain node, batcher and execution-client software (the only op-program file is a one-line constructor signature change), and no Critical or High findings were reported.

reports.title: Mantle EigenDA Integration Security Assessment
reports.description: Sigma Prime time-boxed review (Everest) of mantle-v2 PRs #163, #184 and #185 and op-geth PRs #84, #93 and #95, covering Mantle's EigenDA integration in op-batcher, op-node and op-service, the RIP-7212 precompile and meta-transaction disabling. The scope is entirely offchain node, batcher and execution-client Go code.

reports.title: Mantle Smart Contract Security Assessment (Euboea)
reports.description: Zenith (Code4rena) review of the diff in op-geth PR #103 at commit 3d54b513, which adds pre-confirmation transactions to the txpool and miner (preconf checker, deposit-log parsing). Despite its title the scope is entirely offchain execution-client (sequencer) code.

reports.title: Mantle Network Pre-Confirmation Transactions Audit
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit of the op-geth changes between d28ec49 and 6a7275c plus follow-up PR #103 commits that implement pre-confirmation transactions in the txpool, miner, filters and RPC API. The scope is entirely offchain execution-client (sequencer) code.

reports.title: Security Review For Mantle (Collaborative Audit)
reports.description: Sherlock collaborative audit (July 2 - August 22, 2025) in two parts: the Pectra/Skadi upgrade change set in mantle-v2 (node, batcher, proposer, gas oracle, service code) and op-geth, and Mantle's OP Succinct validity-proof stack, i.e. the kona and op-succinct commit diffs, the whole hydro EigenDA repository and the op-revm BVM_ETH/fee changes in mantle-xyz/revm, each with a final fix commit; five High findings were reported (H-1 and H-2 in the mantle-v2 batcher/EigenDA client, H-3 to H-5 in op-revm deposit BVM_ETH handling), of which H-1 and H-3 were only acknowledged.

reports.title: Mantle Network Security Assessment (Arsia)
reports.description: CertiK diff audit of the Mantle Arsia upgrade, which rebases Mantle on upstream OP Stack v1.16.3 and re-integrates Mantle features, covering listed files of mantle-v2 PR #290 (op-node, op-batcher, genesis tooling and the SystemConfig, GasPriceOracle, L1Block and OperatorFeeVault contracts), op-geth PR #148 (plus the tokenRatio fix PR #152), kona PR #19 and revm PR #20, with per-finding fix commits. One Major finding (MAN-31, latched blob-source flag in the op-node data source factory) was reported and resolved in 984e9ab.
